item.title: Collapse Injures Several Philadelphia Firefighters at Rowhome Blaze
item.description: Nine Philadelphia firefighters were injured, two seriously, as fire engulfed five rowhomes.

item.title: Person Dies in Pod Fire at Portland, OR, Safe Rest Village
item.description: The safe rest village is comprised of pods to provide shelter for unhoused people in Portland and flames consumed a single pod.

item.title: Utica, NY, Council Member Jokes About Hazard Pay During Firefighter Cancer Discussion
item.description: Utica's fire union spoke out after a councilmember joked that firefighters receive hazard pay during a budget discussion where the fire chief was asking for PFAS-free turnout gear.

item.title: Five Kids, Mom Killed in House Fire in Clarksville, OH
item.description: In addition to the children, who ranged in age from nine months to 10, eight firefighters were hurt, Clinton County fire officials said.

item.title: Bill to OK Medical Pot Use by MD Responders Gaining Steam
item.description: The measure would protect firefighters and EMS crews, who are registered medical marijuana patients, from sanctions from their departments.

item.title: Plant Blast in Plaquemine, LA, 'Should Have Never Happened,' Feds Rule
item.description: The 2023 explosion, triggered by a work light, released nearly a decade's worth of chemical emissions within 12 hours, U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard investigators said.

item.title: Radio Flap Leads to Resignation of Seward County, KS, Fire Chief
item.description: "I'm a little busy right now to be lectured about a radio for an administrator...You can fire me," Seward County Fire Chief Andrew Barkely said.

item.title: Staffing Changes Leave One Medic on Albuquerque, NM, Ambulances
item.description: There will be at least one medic and three EMTs on fire trucks now, Albuquerque Fire Chief Emily Jaramillo said.

item.title: Probe Underway after Firefighters Miss Body in Wellston, MO, House Fire
item.description: Family members found the victim's body two days after the Mid County Fire Protection District crews searched.

item.title: Lawyer for Palisades Arson Suspect Wants Charges Dropped after Los Angles Firefighter's Testimony
item.description: Last week, Los Angeles Firefighter Scott Pike said he told others that a brush fire was not extinguished.
